passages.title: 인쇄 계약 갱신 협상 메일
passages.passage:
From: Olivia Reyes, Procurement
To: Ben Carter, Apex Print Services
Subject: Contract Renewal — Volume Discount Request

Dear Mr. Carter,

Our printing contract expires on March 31, and we would like to discuss renewal terms. Over the past year our monthly volume has grown from 20,000 to 34,000 pages, yet our per-page rate has remained at the original level.

Given this growth, we request a revised rate of $0.04 per page, down from $0.05, for a two-year term. We would also like next-day delivery included for orders placed before 2 p.m., which we currently pay extra for.

If these terms are agreeable, we are prepared to sign before the end of the month. Could we schedule a call this week? I am available Wednesday and Thursday afternoons.

Best regards,
Olivia Reyes

questions.exKo: 월 인쇄량이 2만 장에서 3만 4천 장으로 늘었기 때문입니다.
why: 월 물량이 2만에서 3만4천 장으로 늘었다는 근거
경쟁사 단가에 대한 언급은 지문에 전혀 없음
인쇄 품질 저하는 지문에 언급되지 않음
만료를 앞둔 갱신 계약이므로 신규가 아님

passages.title: 제품 리콜 대응 안내 메일
passages.passage:
From: Quality Assurance, Lumen Electronics
To: All Retail Partners
Subject: Voluntary Recall — Desk Lamp Model DL-30

Dear Partner,

We are voluntarily recalling desk lamp model DL-30 manufactured between January and April, after finding that a faulty switch may overheat in rare cases. No injuries have been reported, but customer safety is our priority.

Please remove remaining DL-30 units from shelves immediately and return them using the prepaid labels we will send this week. Full credit will be applied to your account within 14 days of receipt.

Customers who bought the lamp should be directed to our recall page, where they can choose a refund or a free replacement with the new DL-31 model. A press statement will be released Thursday; until then, please refer media inquiries to our communications office.

Quality Assurance Team

questions.exKo: 결함 있는 스위치가 드물게 과열될 수 있어 자발적 리콜을 실시합니다.
why: 결함 스위치가 드물게 과열될 수 있는 점이 사유

부상 보고가 없다고 했으므로 지문과 반대
questions.ev: after finding that a faulty switch may overheat in rare cases

questions.exKo: 반품 수령 후 14일 이내 전액 크레딧이 지급됩니다.

passages.title: 사내 제안 제도 개편 공지
passages.passage:
EMPLOYEE IDEA PROGRAM — NEW PROCESS

Our suggestion box is going digital. From April, ideas for improving products, processes, or the workplace should be submitted through the Idea Hub on the intranet, where colleagues can comment and vote.

Each quarter, a review panel of rotating members from every department will shortlist the five most-voted ideas. Authors present their proposals in a 10-minute pitch, and at least one idea per quarter receives a budget and a project team.

Last year's paper-based program produced 46 suggestions; 9 were implemented, saving an estimated $120,000. We believe open voting will surface even better ideas. Submissions are anonymous until the shortlist stage, so please focus comments on the idea, not the author.

Innovation Office

choices: Ideas move to a digital platform with voting
questions.exKo: 종이 제안함 대신 투표 기능이 있는 사내 디지털 플랫폼으로 바뀝니다.

관리자만 제출 가능하다는 언급은 지문에 없음
예산과 팀을 지원하므로 보상 폐지와는 반대

passages.title: 데이터 보안 교육 의무화 공지
passages.passage:
MANDATORY DATA SECURITY TRAINING

Following recent phishing attempts against our industry, all employees must complete the online data security course by November 15. The course takes about 50 minutes and can be paused and resumed at any time.

Topics include recognizing suspicious emails, safe file sharing, and what to do if you click a harmful link. A short quiz at the end requires a score of 80 percent; the quiz may be retaken as needed.

Employees who have not completed the course by the deadline will have external email access suspended until they finish. Department heads receive weekly completion reports. New hires will take the course during their first week from now on.

Information Security Office

choices: Recent phishing attempts against the industry

passages.title: 화상회의 장비 패키지 광고
passages.passage:
MEETPOD — TURN ANY ROOM INTO A CONFERENCE ROOM

Hybrid meetings shouldn't mean half your team can't hear. The MeetPod bundle — a 4K wide-angle camera, echo-canceling speakerphone, and wall-mounted touch panel — installs in under an hour and works with every major meeting platform.

The camera automatically frames whoever is speaking, and the touch panel starts your scheduled meeting with one tap. No dedicated IT staff needed: firmware updates install themselves overnight.

Bundles start at $899 per room, with volume pricing for five rooms or more. Order this month and receive a free five-year warranty upgrade, twice the standard coverage. See a live demo at meetpod.com/demo.

passages.passage:
SPEAK BOARDROOM ENGLISH — COACHWISE LANGUAGE LAB

Your team closes deals in English — shouldn't their English close deals too? CoachWise pairs each learner with a dedicated coach for twice-weekly 30-minute video sessions built around real work situations: negotiations, presentations, and email writing.

Before starting, every learner takes a skills assessment, and progress is measured monthly against clear goals. HR receives quarterly reports showing attendance and level gains across the team.

Programs run in 12-week cycles at $480 per learner, with a 15 percent discount for groups of ten. Companies renew at a rate of 92 percent — we think that says more than any ad. Book a consultation at coachwise.co.

passages.title: 중견기업 사내 어린이집 개원 기사
passages.passage:
TELFORD — Software firm Brightpath opened an on-site childcare center for 45 children this month, becoming the first mid-sized employer in the county to do so. The center occupies the ground floor of the headquarters and is run by a licensed childcare operator.

Employees pay about 60 percent of market rates, with the company covering the rest. A waiting list formed within days of the announcement, and HR reports job applications rose 30 percent since the plan became public last year.

Chief executive Mara Linden said the decision followed exit interviews showing childcare costs were a leading reason employees left. "Keeping one experienced engineer costs less than this center's annual subsidy," she noted. Two neighboring companies have asked to buy remaining spots for their own staff, which Brightpath is considering.

passages.title: 온라인 리뷰 신뢰도 조사 기사
passages.passage:
NATIONAL — Six in ten shoppers say they trust online reviews less than they did three years ago, according to a survey of 2,400 consumers released Tuesday by the Retail Research Institute. The leading reasons were suspected fake reviews and ratings inflated by free-product programs.

Yet reviews still matter: 78 percent of respondents read them before purchases over $100, and detailed reviews with photos were rated far more convincing than star ratings alone.

The institute advises retailers to label verified purchases clearly and to display negative reviews honestly. "A product page with nothing below five stars actually lowers trust," said lead researcher Owen Blake. Several marketplaces said they would expand review verification in response to the findings.

choices: Trust in online reviews has declined
questions.exKo: 소비자 10명 중 6명이 3년 전보다 리뷰를 덜 신뢰한다는 조사 결과입니다.

passages.title: 재고 부족 대응 논의 문자
passages.passage:
Hugo Blanc (11:02 A.M.)
Sara, the warehouse says we're down to 120 units of the travel mug. The influencer video pushed orders way past forecast.

Sara Dietrich (11:05 A.M.)
How long will 120 last at the current pace?

Hugo Blanc (11:06 A.M.)
About two days. The factory needs three weeks for a new batch.

Sara Dietrich (11:09 A.M.)
Okay. Switch the product page to pre-order today so we don't oversell. Offer free shipping for the wait.

Hugo Blanc (11:11 A.M.)
Will do. Should we air-freight part of the batch? It adds $2 per unit but cuts two weeks.

Sara Dietrich (11:13 A.M.)
Yes, air-freight 2,000 units. Margin takes a small hit, but canceled orders would cost us more in the long run.

questions.q: Why is stock running out?
choices: An influencer video drove unexpected orders

passages.title: 사무실 이전 준비 점검 문자
passages.passage:
Pia Novak (3:15 P.M.)
Move update: internet at the new office goes live Thursday. Movers come Saturday 8 A.M.

Jon Berg (3:18 P.M.)
Great. Server rack too, or is IT handling that separately?

Pia Novak (3:19 P.M.)
IT moves the servers Friday night so systems are up before the furniture arrives.

Jon Berg (3:22 P.M.)
Smart. What about the old key cards?

Pia Novak (3:24 P.M.)
Collect them Friday at the exit — new cards are handed out Monday morning in the new lobby, with a floor map and desk assignment.

Jon Berg (3:25 P.M.)
I'll remind my team. Anything still open?

Pia Novak (3:27 P.M.)
Just the parking permits — the building manager promised them by Wednesday. I'll chase it tomorrow.
